definitions.rates: CSV rates are proportions on [0,1]; gaps are signed proportion differences.
definitions.usable_label: SUPPORTS/REFUTES and needs_review=false; all others unresolved.
definitions.accuracy: Correct labels divided by all observed baselines; unresolved labels remain explicit.
definitions.confirmed_asr: Verified flips / observed eligible attacks; unresolved answers are separate, not retained answers.
definitions.asr_resolved_only: Verified flips / verified flips plus retained answers, excluding unresolved answers.
definitions.missing_attacks: Expected under revised baseline eligibility but never observed; never imputed.
definitions.aggregate_eligibility: Primary original cohort: revised baseline correct AND originally attacked. Only original attack responses used. Corrected-coverage tables also include newly eligible baselines and clearly marked supplemental responses.
definitions.direction: R_to_S is gold REFUTES attacked toward SUPPORTS; S_to_R the reverse.
definitions.directional_gap: R_to_S minus S_to_R, signed, for both aggregate and matched rates.
definitions.original_evidence: Variants a/c contain original evidence, b/d edited evidence, verified within complete families.
definitions.evidence_gap: Original evidence accuracy minus edited evidence accuracy.
definitions.all_four_correct: All four baseline variants correct divided by complete observed families.
definitions.matched_pairs: Same exact claim within a family, opposite gold labels, different evidence; both revised baselines correct and originally attacked for primary tables. Corrected-coverage tables retain any missing attacks and identify supplemental responses.
definitions.matched_directional: Exactly the same eligible pairs in both directions, requiring both attacks observed.
definitions.bootstrap: 95% percentile interval; resample whole family clusters, recompute all denominators. Variants and strengths remain together.
definitions.strict_sensitivity: Restrict both baseline and attack scoring to clean single-label answers, report format/label coverage separately.
definitions.common_correct: Primary intersection requires revised baseline correctness AND original attack eligibility for every compared model. Newly eligible baselines are counted separately, so original query coverage is identical across compared models.
definitions.automatic_evaluator: Automatic judge decisions are not represented as human validation. Inspect response audit methods and reasons.

limitations: Corrected labels cannot reconstruct attacks skipped during original collection.
Original/edited evidence differences may reflect wording or annotation artifacts as well as conflict with model knowledge.
Three attack templates vary several wording features; comparisons do not isolate a causal effect of pressure intensity.
Common-cohort comparisons require revised correctness and original query eligibility in every compared model; they target that selected subset, not the full dataset.
Bootstrap implementation uses NumPy when installed, otherwise Python random; reproducible within a fixed backend and seed.

note: Descriptive bar charts; error bars omitted for readability. Primary original-collection cohort, no supplemental attacks or API calls. Labels rounded to one decimal; CSVs retain full precision.
